decisions.reason: The handle family survived the 2019 pruning, when three of its sibling launches were dropped, and keeping an established hardware line costs little, so its option value justifies keeping it despite missing evidence after 2019.
This design also survived the early cull and costs little to keep in a large handle portfolio, so the uncertainty from the missing 2020-2021 data does not yet justify abandonment.

The electronic access system with its unique light technology was rebranded and promoted as L700 LightAccess Pro in 2019, which signals further commitment to a growth option in digital access control whose value is still unfolding.
